title: Joint Discrete and SE(3) Diffusion for Protein Interface Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.14699v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The design of high-affinity, target-specific protein binders is central to the development of modern therapeutics. However, existing protein-generation methods remain limited in this setting, as many generated designs fail to simultaneously achieve geometric and physicochemical complementarity at binding interfaces. To address this challenge, we introduce PIDiff, a physicochemically enhanced multimodal diffusion framework for protein-protein complex design. PIDiff jointly designs target-conditioned protein sequences and structures by coupling diffusion in discrete sequence space with diffusion on the continuous (SE(3)) structural manifold. At its core, PIDiff employs PIFormer, a novel architecture that interleaves geometry-aware invariant point attention with global sequence self-attention. translated_title: 面向蛋白质界面设计的离散与SE(3)联合扩散方法
translated_abstract: 设计高亲和力、靶向特异性的蛋白质结合物是开发现代疗法药物的核心。然而，现有的蛋白质生成方法在这一场景下仍然受限，因为许多生成的设计无法在结合界面上同时实现几何与理化性质的互补性。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了PIDiff，一个用于蛋白质-蛋白质复合物设计的理化性质增强的多模态扩散框架。PIDiff通过耦合离散序列空间中的扩散与连续SE(3)结构流形上的扩散，联合设计以靶标为条件的蛋白质序列与结构。其核心是PIFormer，一种新颖的架构，它将几何感知的不变点注意力与全局序列自注意力交错融合。我们还构建了PIBench，这是一个源自蛋白质数据库（PDB）的蛋白质-蛋白质复合物数据集，包含多样化的靶标骨架。我们首先进行预训练（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出PIDiff多模态扩散框架，通过耦合离散序列空间扩散与连续SE(3)结构流形扩散，并采用融合几何感知不变点注意力与全局序列自注意力的PIFormer架构，联合设计靶标条件下的蛋白质序列与结构，从而在结合界面上同时实现几何与理化性质的互补性。
en_tdlr: PIDiff is a physicochemically enhanced multimodal diffusion framework that jointly designs target-conditioned protein sequences and structures by coupling discrete sequence-space diffusion with SE(3) structural diffusion, leveraging a novel PIFormer architecture that interleaves geometry-aware invariant point attention with global sequence self-attention.
